description: Brad Chambers is running for Pennsylvania State House District 41 in the Pennsylvania Legislature. HD-41 is located in Lancaster County, PA and includes the municipalities of Columbia Borough, Mountville Borough, East Hempfield Township, West Hempfield Township, and some of Manor Township.
